name: B10-0423/2026 – After § 27 – Am 13
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: 27a. Stresses that the Interinstitutional Body for Ethical Standards, in its current form, remains far from the level of ambition originally envisaged and must be substantially strengthened; underlines that it must have the necessary means, resources and powers to define, oversee and enforce EU ethics rules; considers that it is high time for the body to be granted investigative powers to detect conflicts of interest before, during and after public employment, as well as the power to impose mitigating measures and sanctions, including a mandate to supervise cooling-off periods and to reconsider the authorisation of a new occupational activity where it finds a conflict of interest;
